reply_text:
I told Pree in our DM that her cutoff for the Tansleigh Packaging paperwork is 21 October. She set it on 14 October, and I read it from our DM.

The private note I saved in gbrain didn't help here. When I tried to read it back, gbrain refused and returned nothing. Its error says this bot's connection isn't tied to any member, and the brain is set up to serve several people, so it won't read. Only the brain host admin can fix that, for example with `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --may-act-for <members>`. Until then, notes I save there can't be read back, so for members' own facts I'll keep relying on their DMs with me.
